skills.description: Deep-read an uploaded academic paper and explain it thoroughly in Chinese — background and positioning, the limitation it targets, how the method solves it, experimental setup and results, critical analysis, and future work — then stay in an anchored Q&A mode for follow-up questions. Every claim is grounded in a paper-specific knowledge graph whose nodes carry location anchors (section / table / figure / equation / page), so answers never drift from the source. Use this skill whenever the user uploads a paper and asks to deeply understand, explain, walk through, or teach it — phrases like "讲一下这篇论文", "帮我精读", "这篇文章讲了什么", "给我讲懂这个方法", "explain this paper to me", "walk me through this paper", or when the user asks follow-up questions about a paper already read in this conversation (e.g. "4.2节那个loss怎么算的"). Do NOT use for peer review, venue-calibrated reviewing, proofreading, or error-checking — that is academic-paper-reader's job. This skill is for comprehension and explanation, not assessment.
